caption:
Sincerity: Allah looks at your heart and deeds, not your looks.

The Prophet ﷺ said that Allah does not look at our forms or our wealth, but at our deeds and our hearts. Whatever this Sunday asks of you, let the intention behind it be clean.

Sunan Ibn Majah 4143 · Grade: Sahih

Which deed today will you do only for Allah?

#sincerity #ikhlas #purityofheart #hadith
alt_text: It was narrated that Abu Hurairah, who attributed it to the Prophet (ﷺ), said:“Allah does not look at your forms or your wealth, rather He looks at your deeds and your hearts.” (Sunan Ibn Majah 4143)
